import numpy as np

# Data from treasury bulletin 1942 - individual income tax receipts (in thousands)
years = [1929, 1930, 1931, 1932, 1933, 1934, 1935, 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939, 1940, 1941, 1942]
receipts_thousands = [1095541, 1146845, 833648, 427191, 352573, 419509, 527113, 674416, 1091741, 1286832, 1028834, 982017, 1417655, 3262800]

# Convert to billions (dividing by 1,000,000)
receipts = [r / 1000000 for r in receipts_thousands]

print("Years:", years)
print("Receipts (billions):", receipts)

# Perform OLS regression
X = np.array(years)
y = np.array(receipts)

# Add intercept
X_with_intercept = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)), X])

# Solve using normal equations: beta = (X'X)^(-1) X'y
beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X_with_intercept, y, rcond=None)[0]

intercept, slope = beta
print(f"\nOLS Regression: receipts = {intercept:.6f} + {slope:.6f} * year")

# Project to year 2000
year_2000 = 2000
projected_2000 = intercept + slope * year_2000
print(f"\nProjected value for year 2000: {projected_2000:.6f} billions")

# Actual value for fiscal year 2000 from treasury bulletin 2001
# From the table: Net income taxes = 1,004,461 million = 1004.461 billion
actual_2000 = 1004.461

print(f"Actual value for year 2000: {actual_2000} billions")

# Calculate difference
difference = actual_2000 - projected_2000
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {difference:.6f} billions")
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenth: {round(difference, 1)}")

import math

# Data from treasury bulletin 1942 - individual income tax receipts (in thousands)
years = [1929, 1930, 1931, 1932, 1933, 1934, 1935, 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939, 1940, 1941, 1942]

# Convert to billions (dividing by 1,000,000)

print("Years:", years)
print("Receipts (billions):", receipts)

# Calculate means
n = len(years)
mean_x = sum(years) / n
mean_y = sum(receipts) / n

# Calculate slope and intercept
# slope = sum((x - mean_x)(y - mean_y)) / sum((x - mean_x)^2)
numerator = sum((years[i] - mean_x) * (receipts[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((years[i] - mean_x) ** 2 for i in range(n))
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = mean_y - slope * mean_x

print(f"\nOLS Regression: receipts = {intercept:.6f} + {slope:.6f} * year")

# Project to year 2000
